title: Psychedelic Paradise
description: A surreal painting depicts a pink-skinned woman with large golden butterfly wings standing on a swirling, melting landscape. She holds a glowing golden key upward toward a dripping pink sun and floating eyeballs, surrounded by jellyfish-like creatures, flowers, and a doorway leading to a distant paradise.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a beautiful pink-skinned woman with large golden butterfly wings and flower crown, wearing a form-fitting pink and green bodysuit. She stands on a swirling melting desert landscape holding a glowing golden key toward a dripping pink sun in a swirling sky. Floating eyeballs and bioluminescent jellyfish creatures drift around her. A broken doorway reveals a path to paradise. Text elements read PARADISE, 2ND LOCK, and JNO. Vibrant colors, intricate details, dreamlike atmosphere.
